items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: My husband and I had a little house and we shared this house with another musician, Lloyd Wilson, and his wife.

ctx.x: At a funeral, you know, we get a chance to see everybody. Well, you used to keep up with everybody. And another thing -- of course I'm getting a little ahead of myself again, but you know, I married shortly after I came to California, for the second time, and my son Talmadge

was a little premature baby, so -- and we used to -- we lived not far from -- still in that same neighborhood. It was so wonderful that I managed to live and stay in that same neighborhood all this time, until 1947, you know, when I started recording. Then I moved to the west side. But all this time I lived right up in that area. And the guys used to come to my house. My husband and I had a little house and we shared this house with another musician, Lloyd Wilson, and his wife.
